pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Stellate and lobed dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. Shapes exhibit complex, multi-pointed geometries with significant concave indentations across the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of prominent, light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes typically represent the convergence of three to five pathways with high pixel thickness relative to patch size.
